# B2b — Composition-matched comparison of M5 and VN1 (generated by code/matched_comparison.py)

Series are re-weighted (inverse propensity, 9 shared pre-test features) so that one dataset has the feature distribution of the other. 7 methods (TSB-P excluded). Frontier rank: 1 = least inventory over fill targets 0.90–0.98.

## 1. Does the weighting balance the features? (standardised mean difference VN1 − M5; |SMD| < 0.1 = balanced)

| feature         |   SMD_original |   SMD_VN1_to_M5 |   SMD_M5_to_VN1 |
|:----------------|---------------:|----------------:|----------------:|
| log_mean        |          -0.29 |           -0.03 |           -0.16 |
| log_size        |          -0.1  |           -0.03 |           -0.08 |
| adi             |           0.53 |            0    |            0.43 |
| cv2             |           0.29 |            0.02 |            0.02 |
| zero_share      |           0.91 |            0.04 |            0.44 |
| since_sale      |           0.61 |           -0    |            0.4  |

| recent_ratio_13 |          -0.37 |           -0    |           -0.12 |
| peak_ratio_52   |          -0.05 |            0.04 |           -0.27 |
